test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

NOT108, STY216, XYD324, ?, HIN540
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52e1d176d33dffb76b462a1f9bfa9c9c2a4de35e0a23ccf91ff026ddc513a7be.png] 

Logic followed here is: All the letters are shifted by (+5) to their positional value to get the next letter in the cluster and the (+108) is added in the number to get the next one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1505aea5cf1eba27a21689592c3b04c6932f01697e5e3912dfb055904f060c81.png] 

∴ According to the logic followed **CDI432** will replace the (?)mark.

 Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
